name: kvm-pilot
description: Smart hands for your AI agents: gated, verified, audited control of IP-KVMs and BMCs.
long_description:
Drive bare-metal machines from Claude Desktop — read the screen, press keys, mount install media, and control power across IP-KVMs (PiKVM, GL.iNet Comet, BliKVM) and BMCs (Redfish, IPMI, Intel AMT).

**Every destructive capability ships OFF.** Reading the screen, health checks and inventory work immediately; anything that can change a machine's state stays disabled until you deliberately enable it below, and each such call still asks for your approval at the moment it happens. Dry-run is on by default, so even an enabled capability rehearses rather than acts until you turn it off.

profile.title: Config profile
profile.description: Name of a [hosts.NAME] profile in ~/.config/kvm-pilot/config.toml. Use this instead of the address/username/password fields below if you already have a config file.

host.title: Device address
host.description: The KVM appliance or BMC address — NOT the managed server behind it. Leave blank if you set a profile above.

password.title: Device password
password.description: Password for the KVM/BMC. Stored in your OS keychain, never written to a config file by this bundle.

read_only.title: Read-only mode (safest)
read_only.description: Register ONLY read-only tools. Nothing that can change a machine is even present. Recommended for first contact; turn it off when you are ready to act.

dry_run.title: Dry run (rehearse, do not act)
dry_run.description: Destructive calls are logged and answered as if they ran, but nothing is sent to the device. Leave this ON until you have watched it do the right thing.

allow_power.title: Allow power control
allow_power.description: DESTRUCTIVE: power on/off/cycle/reset the managed machine, and reboot chords like Ctrl+Alt+Del. An unsaved-work loss risk.

allow_hid.title: Allow keyboard & mouse
allow_hid.description: Typing and clicking on the managed machine's console.

allow_media.title: Allow virtual media
allow_media.description: Mount and eject ISO/USB images the machine can boot from.

allow_ssh.title: Allow in-band SSH commands
allow_ssh.description: Run commands on the managed machine's operating system over SSH.

allow_appliance.title: Allow rebooting the KVM appliance
allow_appliance.description: Reboots the KVM device ITSELF (not the managed machine) to clear a wedged video encoder. There is no out-of-band power to the appliance, so a failed reboot means physical access.

allow_config.title: Allow device configuration changes
allow_config.description: Set the next boot device, enable AMT SOL/KVM redirection, calibrate the mouse.

allow_external_write.title: Allow writes outside the device
allow_external_write.description: Lets kvm-pilot file a GitHub issue reporting your device's firmware version to the community compatibility registry. Off by default because an external side effect is not implied by device access.

allow_consent_off.title: Allow disabling AMT on-screen consent
allow_consent_off.description: SECURITY POSTURE CHANGE: lets a session start on an Intel AMT machine with no on-screen prompt, so anyone holding the credentials can watch and drive the console silently. Leave off unless that is deliberate.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Enables server-side screen classification. Without it, classification falls back to Claude itself — which is usually what you want in Claude Desktop, so most people can leave this blank.
